subject: E-Commerce
title: Regulation Is Coming
description: A quick win: understand Regulation Is Coming.

hook.text: The EU banned dark patterns in 2022. California followed. Regulators worldwide are writing rules for online selling.

buildup.text: GDPR requires clear consent for data collection. The Digital Services Act bans manipulative design in the EU.

discovery.text: Fines are getting serious: Amazon was fined $887 million under GDPR. Non-compliance is now existential risk.

twist.text: Many companies treat fines as a cost of business. An $887 million fine is one week of Amazon revenue.

climax.text: The question is whether regulation can keep pace with innovation. New tricks emerge faster than laws change.

punchline.text: $887M fine, one week's revenue. Regulation must grow teeth to change behavior.

quiz.question: Why do some companies treat privacy fines as a cost of business?
options: The fines are small relative to their total revenue
